mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening cycle that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low housing market regime (HOUST < 2000.0), a decline in housing starts signals reduced consumer confidence and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 2000.0 and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
